$comment: Ledger for specs that CANNOT run in CI and can only be run by hand.
Checked by scripts/gate/manual-coverage.mjs, which runs in the NIGHTLY, not in
pnpm gate. That placement is deliberate: a check blocking every PR until
someone runs an extension test by hand gets cleared by typing a date, and then
there are two mechanisms lying instead of one. In the nightly a stale record
opens a tracking issue through the failure sink — visible and dated, and
A date alone is not a record. Each entry must name the extension versions it
ran against and the actual result, so a rubber stamp is at least conspicuous.

apps/demo/e2e/a2-two-extension-isolation.notes: NEVER RECORDED. The spec was written 2026-06-10 in 27e5b68 and carried `|| !!process.env.CI`, so it has never run in CI and no by-hand run was ever written down. This null entry is the honest starting state, and it fails the check on purpose: the alternative is a ledger that opens by asserting a run nobody can point to.
